summary: A busy, locked or unopenable SQLite database during signature verdict reconciliation or the signature migration is retried and no longer persisted as signature-state-corrupt; a stopped migration no longer rewraps its own fault at each start; st replication signatures resume (a person or the fleet's fault agent) clears a persisted fault and wakes the migration

schema.detail: No table or claim schema change. Resume clears the existing fault columns of claim_signature_migration.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or retention rule change.

compatibility.detail: No wire or stored format change. New route POST /v1/signatures/resume; a bound harness may name only itself.

downtime.detail: None. After a resume, verdicts admitted while the fault stood are judged by the next verdict pass, in writer loans.

manual.detail: A member that already persisted a transient error as signature-state-corrupt keeps it until a person or the fleet's fault agent runs st replication signatures resume --reason TEXT on it.

recovery.detail: Revert the build: transient errors are persisted as faults again and the resume command is gone. A fault cleared by resume stays cleared.
